discoveries.headline: Deepest eclipse among the clean candidates
discoveries.blurb: The primary eclipse removes 42.04% of the light, the deepest of any candidate with no open caveats. Measured: orbital period 9.1248 days, detection signal-to-noise 1068. A secondary eclipse is also detected, at 584.7 sigma. It matched none of the 6 catalogs searched, which is weak evidence of novelty. It is a candidate, not a confirmed eclipsing binary.
